reason: Add a pricing policy for managed services of the SEO/AEO practice: target margin 55%, floor 45%. The practice floor was approved on 2026-07-13 but the catalog had no offer for it, so an SEO programme could only borrow the creative offer (target equal to floor). CEO decision of 2026-10-11. Existing policies are untouched.

record.note: Managed service of the SEO/AEO practice. Floor 45% of margin on all costs: approved by the CEO on 2026-07-13 for the practice and reaffirmed on 2026-10-11. Target 55%: the low end of the 55-60% band of that policy, proposed by the agent and confirmed by the CEO on 2026-10-11. Applying it to an engagement remains a per-case review, not an approved price.
